title: 3 Commonly Mispronounced Words: Are You Saying Them Right? #shorts
description:
Three commonly mispronounced words in English, with the correct pronunciation.
• Wednesday: WENZ-day
• Salmon: SAM-un
• Island: EYE-lund

Listen to each word twice, first slowly and then at normal speed, and say it out loud.

Which word did you say wrong? Write it in the comments.

Find another word for any word on anotherwordfor.net

#pronunciation #learnenglish #shorts
